headline: Tabled South Colony Street applications, approved a fence at 23A Country Way, and released a bond at 932 Northford Road.
summary: A dog fence through wetlands at 23A Country Way would cross about 52 linear feet of wetland. Approval requires the fence posts to be hand-dug. A notice of violation went out over erosion at 60 Carpenter Lane.
decisions: Approved finding that the 23A Country Way fence is not a significant impact activity.
Approved Daniel Riley's fence at 23A Country Way, with the posts hand-dug.
Tabled applications 26-10.1 and A26-10.2 on South Colony Street.
Approved releasing the bond on 932 Northford Road.
discussion: 23A Country Way fence: Views differed on moving the fence farther from the wetland, since the dog needs an easy path from the house. Hand-digging the posts was raised as a way to limit equipment impact.
Erosion at 60 Carpenter Lane: Erosion controls were in place but not as the commission approved them, so a notice of violation went out. No sediment was reaching the wetland area outside the URA.
360 Woodhouse Avenue pipe: Remediation work started under an approved permit. A pipe that shot water to the southern wetland was removed, but the new pipe still differs from the approved plans.

250 Cook Hill Road enforcement: Past notices and orders have not brought compliance, so talks with the law department on further action continue. Members also suggested that the planning and zoning department might help with the amount of material placed on the property.
Meeting packet quality: The chair said the packets were hard to read, with small print and pages out of order, and asked that they be fixed before the next meeting.

decision_evidence.quote: Mr. Chairman, I like to make a motion that a application A26-9.1, 23A Country Way, Daniel Riley, a proposed fence, be deemed not a significant impact activity. ... Motion made and seconded. Call for a vote. Aili? Yes.

Mr. Chairman, I'd like to make a motion that application A26-9.1, 23A Country Way, Daniel Riley, proposed fence, be approved with the condition of hand-digging the post for the fence. ... Okay, motion made, seconded, I call for a vote. Aili? Yes. Nick? Yes. Deb? Yes. Yes. Yes. You're all set.
Okay, so the application 26-10.1 is tabled. ... Okay, so they're both tabled.
Mr. Chairman, I like to make a motion that of the bond be released on property 932 Northrup Road. ... Call for a vote. Ally? Yes.
